redirects.//: The board lives at '/'. /rooms was published in the old sitemap and is what people type — a 301 (permanent) rather than a client-side redirect so the link equity actually transfers.

headers.//: Hashed build output (outputHashing: all) can never go stale under a given name, so it is cached for a year. This is the single largest repeat-visit win on a slow connection.
Security headers. Lighthouse Best Practices checks HSTS and clickjacking protection; these move that category to 100 and cost nothing at runtime.
Staging must never be indexed. environment.staging.ts already emits a noindex meta tag; this header covers non-HTML responses and any crawler that reads headers before rendering.
